notes: Damage fixes: Asprint was one-shotting (140 HP plus a splash) - it now does exactly 35 and the impact blast no longer adds damage. Piercer now does 8 a shot (it was 24). Vampire heavily nerfed: 5 HP a tick, about 30 over a full drain (it was well over 100). Weapon tooltips now show the real damage you deal.
Asprint: damage up to 35, cooldown down to 7.5s.

6 new weapons: Vampire, Healing Beam, Antidote, Miasma, Borrowed Life and Jammer (MEDICAL/SUPPORT). Weapon balance: Piercer, Velocity Cannon (now a travelling bolt, not instant), Asprint, Air Burst, Sonic Boom, Thorn Burst (now a true sphere burst), Arbalest and Blink Edge all changed. Bots now cycle between 6 weapons instead of 3. New AI difficulty slider in Settings. Weapon tooltips show average damage, reload and magazine size. Crystal Wall is now a thin glowing hex-grid panel. Big Toilet, Desert Camper, Garden of Eden and Seaside Village doubled in size; Tunnels is now 7x7 with more room variety.

NAME CREATOR trailer tools, in Practice: FREECAM flies the camera freely through the map, detached from the ball (WASD/stick to move, jump/dash for up/down, mouse to look). PICTURE MODE hides every HUD overlay for a clean shot. CINEMATIC adds widescreen letterbox bars and a vignette. All three are NAME CREATOR only and reset automatically when you leave practice.
New staff title: NAME CREATOR (pink), unlocked with the NAMECREATOR_CODE server code. Title only, same as Customer Service - no moderator or owner powers.

Legion Ball is now Ballistic. Renamed everywhere players see it: the title screen, window title, main menu, credits and error messages. Existing players keep their settings, keybinds, staff code and device ID automatically the next time they launch.

Reworked 8 maps that used other companies' characters or places into original versions: Enterprise is now Starship (an original arrowhead hull), plus Darkhaven, Desert Camper, Endless Fortress, Seaside Village, Station Trench, Superspeedway and Big Oval. The Portal Gun is now the Rift Gun. Added a first-time tutorial, full controller and Steam Deck support, display options (window mode, resolution, UI scale), and crash-safe settings saves. Fixed camera clipping through ceilings, a turret error on join, and huge load-in freezes on Endless Fortress, Backrooms and Eden (down from up to 9s to under half a second).

BIG UPDATE: 3 new modes (King of the Hill, Gun Game, Juggernaut), 5 new weapons (Plasma Net, Fibonacci Cannon, Hyper Dash, Air Burst, Asprint), 8 new maps (Jungle Gym, Parthenon, Garden of Eden, Endless Fortress, Big Toilet, Desert Camper, Seaside Village, Backrooms). Kill feed shows weapons, rainbow owner tag, CS tag, pylon parry fix, controller menu scrolling, separate controller yaw/pitch sensitivity, speedometer volume, fix for falling through floors, Arbalest rebalance, marked players on the minimap.
New CREDITS tab. Owners can update the credits from the main menu without a game update.
Way more warping (speed, dash, weapons, nearby blasts) and much better explosions: fireball, smoke, embers, core flash, ground ring, double sparks.

Testers can now switch maps. Mods and the owner can FLY (V; Space up, C down) - and anyone can in practice. New numpad staff keys: Numpad 0 opens the moderation menu, Numpad Enter opens quick moderation actions (then Numpad 1-9). Owner health is back to the normal 100.

Big performance boost with no change to the graphics: the minimap was redrawing the whole map every frame, and maps drew thousands of separate pieces. Frame rates are up to 8x higher (Darkhaven went from about 50 to over 400 FPS).

Bots now always hold the gun they fire (weapon locks were leaving them stuck on the Gatling). New PRACTICE ADMIN page in the practice pause menu: gold shield, low gravity, launch yourself, and set your own speed.
Fixed a crash when leaving a server (or when the server drops you).

Big graphics and quality-of-life update. GRAPHICS: quality presets (Low to Ultra), sun shadows, anti-aliasing, ambient occlusion, reflections, render scale, frame cap, and glowing speed trails. COMBAT FEEDBACK: hit markers and kill markers on the crosshair, red arrows showing where hits come from, and a red screen edge at low health. AUDIO: Master and Effects volume sliders. Also: FPS / ping counter, invert mouse Y, and a reorganised Settings page.

Coliseum, The Box, Thunder Dome, City, Superspeedway, Atlantis, El Dorado, Military Base, The House, Station Trench, Starship, Darkhaven and Chess Board are now twice as big. Ramps out of the Atlantis canals and the Station Trench trench (no more getting stuck).

Owner: set anyone's max health and speed (including your own) from the moderation page. Fixed flickering (z-fighting) on Station Trench, City, Castle, The House, Darkhaven, Military Base and Atlantis. Big Oval/Superspeedway stand roofs no longer float, and Superspeedway's lake is back. Arbalest: shoves much harder and pins targets to any wall behind them (up to 14 m).
Players can now turn bots off (or back on) for the whole server from the pause menu: [ BOTS: ON/OFF ].
Menu buttons no longer reload the menu: changing the UI colour, equipping weapons, weapon locks and other staff actions now update the page in place and keep your scroll position.

11 NEW MAPS: Castle, Superspeedway, Big Oval, Atlantis, El Dorado, Military Base, The House (10:1 scale, with vents), Station Trench, Starship, Darkhaven, Chess Board. TEAM DEATHMATCH mode. Smash-style map and mode vote at the end of every match. AI BOTS fill matches with fewer than 4 players. Match timer on the scoreboard. Servers 3 and 4 are CLASSIC (original six weapons). Armory: press a slot to open a weapon picker with pictures and details. UI colour setting. DualSense motion aiming (R3 recenters). Staff weapons in practice for everyone. Fixed: chat unread counter, PlayStation X now selects. New game icon.
Weapon blades fit tighter and smaller round the ball, and still never go through it.

Balance pass. NERFS: Echo Rifle (lower damage, half-damage echo, 5-round magazine + reload), Beam Lance, Frost Lance; every lock-on now uses a small Gatling-size circle. BUFFS: Stasis Mine, Gravity Well (stronger pull, no dashing out), Splinter Bomb, Shard Mortar, bigger Crystal Wall, Arc Pylon and Spike Carpet 6x range, Thorn Burst, Piercer, faster Arbalest, homing Ricochet Disc, Meteor Drop, Executioner 69 damage, longer Saber deflect, real Winglets glide, Hunter's Sigil tags on the minimap, Mirage decoys steal enemy locks. Time Dilator fixed: enemies inside move and fire slowly, turrets stop. Melee weapons (Saber, Shock Knuckle, Buzzsaw) kill in one hit. Tears of an Angel back to Swarm-style wings.
The owner now has 1000 health.

Bigger blades (1.4x) that now wrap AROUND the ball instead of through it. Bigger ranges and areas on the new weapons. Lock-on for long-range weapons: Frost Lance, Gravity Well, Prism Cage, Echo Rifle, Splinter Bomb, Skylance, Shard Mortar, Beam Lance, Piercer, Arbalest, Ricochet Disc, Velocity Cannon and Hunter's Sigil.

THE ARSENAL: all 31 new weapons are playable. Drag them into your loadout in the Armory - freeze lances, gravity wells, cages, mines, time bubbles, teleport blades, jetpacks, wings, meteor slams, rideable spears, mortars, walls, tesla pylons, spike traps, drones, sabers that deflect shots, dash punches, buzzsaws, decoys, ramping lasers, piercing rifles, pinning crossbows, bouncing discs, and speed weapons. Equip three from one combo group for its set bonus.

LEGION BALL 1.0: LOADOUTS. Build your own kit in the Armory: drag six weapons into your slots (keys 1-6), grouped into seven combo groups - equip three from one group for its set bonus. Thirty new weapons are previewed as NOT BUILT YET. Every weapon now has its own colour and blade layout; god weapons are the only white ones.
Tears of an Angel now flies straight through walls, and Tears and Rain of God leave a white ripple and warp on both sides of every wall they pass through.

New staff weapon for mods and the owner: TEARS OF AN ANGEL (slot 8), a white Swarm with unlimited range and locks, missiles that fire one by one at twice the speed, deal 25 damage and steer round walls - but a parried tear kills you. Pillars of God moves to slot 9.
New UPDATES page in the menu with every past update, and a what's-new message the first time you open a new version.
Fix: falling into the void now counts as one death instead of several.
Fixes: impact frames now stay on the kill when you turn the camera, and everyone can see Tether ropes (not just the player using it).
Staff tools: the owner can lock specific weapons, launch players, heal/freeze everyone and turn on low gravity; mods can slay, freeze, mute and make announcements; testers can jump to players.
Staff powers: mods and the owner can BRING players (or everyone) to them and switch maps; the owner can also KILL ALL and lock or unlock everyone's weapons.

AI turrets are now off by default. Staff (owner, mod, tester) can turn them on for a server from the pause menu; in practice anyone can. Turret shots can be parried with the shield, and turrets can be stunned (Nova, parries) and destroyed.
Menu pages (armory, global chat and the rest) now stretch to the right edge of the screen.

Five new maps (Coliseum, The Box, Thunder Dome, Tunnels, City), end-of-match map vote, AI turrets, music, controller support, killstreak counter, map build-in cutscene, global chat in the main menu, holstered healing, Tether airborne lock-on and wall blast, faster dash, and fixes: armory clipping, reload on death, falling off the map now counts as a death.

Pillars of God is far more dramatic: 1.6s wind-up with a closing ring of light and a map-wide charge sound, a three-layer pillar, shockwaves, a huge new impact sound, and impact frames for everyone nearby.
Weapon wheel back on the left, styled like the old menu (scroll + right-click). Minimap now shows the whole map, north up.
Radial weapon menu (mouse wheel, point with the mouse, right-click to equip). See who's online on each server before joining. Rebind every key in Controls.
Fix: chat no longer gets stuck if you click, shoot or die while typing.
Server chat (/) and global chat across all servers (Right Shift). Version check: mismatched game versions can't join. Other players' reloads are now visible. Manual reload on T.
Servers 3 and 4 now run the Training map (no cubes or targets). Server buttons show each server's map.
The owner can now kick and ban moderators (and testers, as mods can). Nobody can kick or ban the owner.
Impact frames now shade weapon blades and shields (lit, shadowed and outlined like the rest of the world).
Owner gold shield: press G to become invincible (server-checked); everyone sees the gold shell.
Rain of God now for moderators too. Key 0 hides/shows staff weapons. Rain of God and Pillars of God are unparryable (go through shields).
Everyone now sees every kill's impact frames (styled by the killer's weapon). Hitstop still only for the killer and victim.

Staff codes: OWNER_CODE (mod tools, owner weapons Rain of God + Pillars of God, gold OWNER title), MOD_CODE, TESTER_CODE (green TESTER title). Owner weapons also work in practice once a server has confirmed the code.
Moderators: enter the moderator code in Settings to get a MODERATION page in the pause menu (kick, ban, end match) and a [MOD] tag. The server checks the code.
4 online servers: pick SERVER 1-4 in Multiplayer (8 players each). A full server now says so instead of dropping you.
Fix: railgun lock-on was unreliable (and so the red locked-on warning rarely showed). Lock now updates every physics step.
Screen edges glow red while someone's railgun is locked onto you, stronger as their shot charges. Everyone (and the server) needs this version to play together.
Gatling and railgun lock on at any range (line of sight only); railgun bolt reaches across the map. Scatter has aim assist and holds damage further out.
Tether slam now one-shots anyone in the blast (shields and spawn protection still block it).

New online map 'Sprawl': huge irregular arena with 150 m outer walls, a walled hub, ring road and spokes to break line of sight. Minimap (top-left) that only shows players you can see. Tether pulls harder with more tension.
Every weapon has its own impact frames, scaled to how hard it hits. Railgun keeps the full one.
Railgun now fires a laser bolt that flies out and only hits when it arrives. Kills give you 30 integrity back.
Swarm rockets are way faster. Dummy targets removed (drones and ground targets stay). Huge new explosion sound after the impact frames.
Nova has no cooldown, launches you far higher and slams you down at top speed (stun needs 60% charge). Impact frames now have a rising implosion sound that ends in a big explosion.

Gatling now has a 30-shot magazine with a 1.6s reload. Shield cooldown 6s. Dash down in the air by looking down. Railgun has no damage dropoff. Parries strike back at the shooter: 20 damage and a 5s stun.

Big balance pass: every weapon rebalanced so none is best. Damage numbers show damage and distance. Damage dropoff and max lock-on range per weapon. Scatter is now a pump shotgun that can one-shot point-blank. Marks 1.5x for 3s, Nova stun 1.2s.
Smoother 3D impact frames (real shadows and lighting from the kill). About 20% faster overall. Tether can't be used to fly anymore (rope snaps after 3s). Much less steering in the air.

Hold your speed: dashes now stack up to 500 while you keep steering forward. New implosion-to-explosion kill frames with manga shading. Smaller Gatling lock-on. Blocking a hit resets the shield cooldown.
Block (Q) shield + parry, speedometer, sounds, warmer lighting, Nova air slam, Tether slam, Gatling lock-on, longer-range Scatter, and lots of fixes.
Online server: play over the internet (works on school Wi-Fi) with the new ONLINE SERVER button.
Lobby shows the right address (hides virtual adapters); clearer connection-timeout help.
Update pipeline test (no gameplay changes).
First release: multiplayer PvP, six weapons, auto-updates.
